podcast.body: Written by Christine McVie about a fling she had with a lighting technician in 1976 during her breakup with John McVie. This groovy and sensual song echoed McVie's earlier "woolly blues rock" for Fleetwood Mac but with a much brighter tone. It peaked at number nine in December 1977, making "Rumours" the first single artist LP in chart history to generate four top ten hits. "Christine McVeah wrote, You Make Loving Fun, about a fling she had with a lighting technician in 1976, while in the midst of breaking up with John."
